serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Salesforce is the #1 CRM, enabling public sector organizations to modernize service.

Salesforce helps public sector organizations to transform digital service delivery, achieve faster time to value, and improve mission success with automation tools, purpose-built solutions, and smart insights that help move the mission forward - all within a compliant cloud environment. Government Cloud Plus is a dedicated instance of Salesforce’s industry leading Platform as a Service (PaaS) and Software as a Service (SaaS) applications, enabling organizations to scale and secure apps on an authorized government cloud so they can accelerate mission success. Government Cloud Plus has been designed to provide high levels of performance, reliability, and security.
